newsitem.title: CHINA: Handover homing pigeons prefer Hong Kong to China.
newsitem.headline: Handover homing pigeons prefer Hong Kong to China.

text.p: It's not only illegal immigrants who think Hong Kong is paradise -- hundreds of Chinese homing pigeons released in celebration of the handover are staging a sit-in and refusing to fly home.
Some 10,000 mainland pigeons were freed on Tuesday in the ex-British colony to mark Hong Kong's return to China.
But many of them have dug their claws in and stayed put, the South China Morning Post said on Friday.
The birds were supposed to fly back to provinces all over China. But torrential rain in the region's worst storms for 50 years may have deterred them.
An official said authorities had received dozens of calls from residents who spotted hundreds of wet pigeons on the roofs.
"Most of them have gone but just like people these pigeons have their own characteristics and some don't want to go," she said. Authorities would feed them until the weather improved.
